evidence.sql: WITH portfolio_totals AS (SELECT p.portfolio_name, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_value FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name), tech_totals AS (SELECT p.portfolio_name, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_value FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = :sector_name GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name) SELECT t.portfolio_name, t.tech_value, pt.total_value, ROUND((t.tech_value * 100.0) / pt.total_value, 2) AS tech_percentage FROM tech_totals t JOIN portfolio_totals pt ON t.portfolio_name = pt.portfolio_name ORDER BY tech_percentage DESC
